title: AE2: EMI network-inventory & synthetic-fav backport
description: Backports EMI's AE2 support to Minecraft 1.20.4, incl. microcrafting tools like synthetic favs and inventory-tracking.
body:
This is a tiny, pure backport of [Applied Energistics 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)'s `provideNetworkInventoryToEmi` feature (AE2 PR [#8215](https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8215), by [@ramidzkh](https://modrinth.com/user/ramidzkh)), to v1.20.4, for NeoTech and similar modpacks from the era.

This enables EMI's "synthetic favourites" / crafting-tree / registration and tracking of partially-complete in-progress crafts, when using AE2 terminals.

This only applies code already accepted upstream.

----

I'm using this in my own saves; but it's primarily AI-written; use with a grain of salt. (I'm an experienced dev, and I did put in the effort to ensure this has a minimum of quality, though.)
